encounters.cc: Episodic shakiness, anxiety, and palpitations occurring several times a week, relieved by eating.

lines: Episodic shakiness, anxiety, and palpitations occurring several times a week, relieved by eating.
The patient is a 67-year-old male with a history of pancreatic adenocarcinoma status post partial pancreatectomy and type 2 diabetes mellitus who presents for evaluation of hypoglycemic symptoms.
He reports episodic shakiness, anxiety, and palpitations that have occurred several times a week over the past month.
These episodes tend to occur a few hours after meals and are relieved by eating.
His wife has noticed that he becomes sweaty, irritable, and confused during the episodes, but he usually improves rapidly after consuming juice or a snack.
He has since been receiving regular injections to control his blood sugar.
His appetite between meals has increased, and he has unintentionally lost 5 lb (2.3 kg).
He is adherent to his medications and attends all follow-up visits.

encounters.cc: Found unresponsive at home requiring intubation for airway protection.

lines: Found unresponsive at home requiring intubation for airway protection.

This 70-year-old male with a history of Zenker diverticulum, pancreatic adenocarcinoma status post partial pancreatectomy, and alcoholic cirrhosis is admitted to the intensive care unit after being found unresponsive at home.
On arrival, he is intubated for airway protection and started on intravenous fluids and broad-spectrum antibiotics for presumed aspiration pneumonia.
Over the next 10 days, his infection improves, but he remains lethargic and dependent on mechanical ventilation.
A nutritional consult reveals he is mildly underweight.
Laboratory studies are sent to evaluate persistent encephalopathy.
